images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a tabletop marionette theater game. Front-on camera from the audience seats: a miniature proscenium stage with heavy crimson velvet curtains, gold fringe valance, warm tungsten spotlight cone with drifting dust, painted moonlit castle backdrop, polished wooden stage floor in perspective. At top center an old wrinkled hand grips a wooden puppet control bar; thin pale strings run down to a blue-gowned princess marionette mid-bow, slightly motion-blurred from hand tremor. A dashed golden ghost outline shows the target pose beside her. Dark silhouettes of audience heads in the foreground. HUD: a torn parchment script card bottom-left, a dark gauge panel bottom-right with a jittery tremor waveform and a pose-match bar, five small puppet portraits top-right. Brass plaque at top reading "공주의 인사", gauge labels "손 떨림 37%" and "자세 일치". Painterly realism, film grain, deep vignette, palette of crimson, amber gold and umber.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the final night of a marionette theater game. Same audience-seat camera but the crimson curtains are half closed and dimmed, a flickering dying spotlight, cold blue wash over the stage. The old puppeteer's hand at top trembles violently, shown with motion-blur ghost copies of the control bar. Strings hang slack and tangled, one snapped string glows red at its broken end. The princess marionette lies collapsed on the wooden floor, crown fallen beside her. In the dark foreground a single small child silhouette raises both arms, still clapping. Top-left a cool-toned tremor panel reading "손 떨림 91%", top-right seven night markers with the last one glowing amber. Centered serif subtitle monologue and a softly pulsing pill button "한 번만 더 들어 올린다". Melancholic painterly realism, heavy film grain, vignette, desaturated crimson against steel blue and one warm amber pool of light.
